"""Sentinel-generated confirming test for INC-ced659fd (payments).

Hypothesis: The /pay requests are spending extra time in the gateway path: slow upstream calls hit a 50ms timeout, then charge() retries them, so a single slow payment can add multiple timeout delays before still returning 200. The shown email qaaaa...@example.org does not match the fraud filter, so the request reaches the gateway instead of being short-circuited.
"""
import statistics
import time
import tracemalloc

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from payments.app import app

client = TestClient(app)


def _call(method, url, body):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    response = client.request(method, url, content=body or None, headers={"content-type": "application/json"})
    return response, (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000


REQUEST = ('POST', '/pay', '{"email":"qaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa@example.org","amount":243.23}')
BUDGET_P50_MS = 14.4  # pre-incident p50 4.38 ms, with margin
BUDGET_P95_MS = 111.1  # pre-incident p95 55.57 ms, with margin


def test_incident_request_stays_within_latency_budget():
    _call(*REQUEST)  # warm-up
    timings = sorted(_call(*REQUEST)[1] for _ in range(20))
    assert statistics.median(timings) <= BUDGET_P50_MS, timings
    assert timings[18] <= BUDGET_P95_MS, timings
